capacity_gross_kwh.notes: InsideEVs (Volvo US 2025 release): Twin Motor versions get the 82 kWh pack, up from 78. CONFLICT: Green Car Reports says the 2025 dual-motor keeps 78 kWh. 82 is supported by the rated range rise (254 to 260 mi) and KBB 82 kWh for the 2026 Twin.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: EV Database (European 82 kWh pack, 108s1p prismatic NMC): 79.0 kWh usable; Volvo UK press (search excerpt) calls the pack 82/79 kWh nominal/usable. From 2025 the Twin moved from 78 to 82 kWh (Volvo US pricing release via InsideEVs; EPA 260 mi vs 254 mi; KBB 82 kWh for the 2026 Twin).
